```{r load packages, echo=F, warning=F, include=FALSE}
load_or_install_libraries <- function(x){
  for( i in x ){
    #  require returns TRUE invisibly if it was able to load package
    if( ! require( i , character.only = TRUE ) ){
      #  If package was not able to be loaded then re-install
      install.packages( i , dependencies = TRUE )
      #  Load package after installing
      require( i , character.only = TRUE )
    }
  }
}
```

## create gmr/hmr shapefiles
```{r}

# read your polygon (any supported format)
gal_buffer_poly <- st_read(here::here("data", "shapefiles", "Combined_buffer_30nm.geojson" ))
aoi2_poly <- st_read(here::here("data", "shapefiles", "AOI2_altamar_ZEE.geojson" ))

# convert to WKT
gal_buffer_poly$wkt <- st_as_text(gal_buffer_poly$geometry)
aoi2_poly$wkt <- st_as_text(aoi2_poly$geometry)
# Convert to WKT and pull the first exact text string
wkt_string_aoi2 <- as.character(aoi2_poly$wkt[1])

```


## VMS gaps query
```{r}

start_date <- "'2026-04-01 00:00:00 UTC'" 
end_date <- "'2026-07-01 00:00:00 UTC'" 
# gap_dur_h <- 3

wkt_string <- wkt_string_aoi2

# load query
VMS_query <- readr::read_file(here::here("queries", "GALAPEX_VMS.sql"))

## select vessel lists
VMS_gaps <- 
  fishwatchr::gfw_query(query = glue::glue(VMS_query, 
                                                    start_date = start_date,
                                                    end_date = end_date,
                                                    wkt_string = wkt_string),
                                                    # prev_visit_search_date = prev_visit_search_date),
                                 run_query = TRUE,
                                 con = con)$data

PAN_encounters_vois$gfw_potential_risk <- as.logical(PAN_encounters_vois$gfw_potential_risk)
PAN_encounters_amp_novois$gfw_potential_risk <- as.logical(PAN_encounters_amp_novois$gfw_potential_risk)

```
